Introduction page

Source: R/page-introduction.R
introduction_ui.Rd

The app's opening screen: one card that shows the app's introduction text in the chosen language. The text is the Markdown file 0_intro_<language>.md in the app's help folder, which an app sets with options(cd2030.help_dir = ) (by default "help"). When there is no file for the language, the English one (0_intro_en.md) is shown. The page reads nothing from the dataset.

Usage

introduction_ui(id, i18n)

introduction_server(id, selected_language)

Arguments

id

The module's id.

i18n

The app's translator (a shiny.i18n translator), used for the card's title.

selected_language

A reactive that returns the code of the language picked in the app (for example "en"). While it does not hold one non-empty string, the page uses the language the app's translator is set to, and English if that cannot be read.

Value

introduction_ui() returns the page's UI as Shiny tags. introduction_server() is called for its side effects.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# the folder that holds 0_intro_en.md, 0_intro_fr.md and so on
options(cd2030.help_dir = system.file("intro", package = "cd2030.rmncah"))

# in the app's UI, and in its server function
introduction_ui("introduction", i18n = i18n)
introduction_server("introduction", selected_language = reactive(input$selected_language))
} # }
